basic_details.job_title: CDSCO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Additional Drugs Controller, Joint Drugs Controller and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Additional Drugs Controller (I), Joint Drugs Controller (I), Deputy Drugs Controller (I)
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 13A (Additional Drugs Controller), Level 13 (Joint Drugs Controller), Level 12 (Deputy Drugs Controller) of the 7th CPC

how_to_apply: Complete the application and attach the requisite documents listed in the Detailed Advertisement (Annexure-I).
Forward the application through the proper channel.
Send it to the Deputy Director Admn. (Drugs), CDSCO (HQ), FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi – 110002.
Send it within 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 25 December 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications or applications without the requisite documents are liable to be rejected The circular may be circulated among Ministries/Departments, State Governments, UT Administrations and other organisations
